findings.title: Landscape editor is blank despite a nonzero draft count
findings.observation: The visible writing region contains no draft text, while the toolbar shows 1,332 / 20,000 and an enabled primary action. Both page header and full composer are in the viewport.
findings.impact: The user cannot visually check the nonempty draft from this captured state, creating a direct editing/review problem. The still does not establish data loss or a root cause.

resolution.observation: The landscape editor now visibly shows the complete trailing Chinese sentence, and the 390x440 editor shows its final two lines. Both retain expansion, selected-material count, character count and primary action. The original blank presentation is no longer present.
resolution.tradeoff: Supplied geometry shows input height increasing from 72 to 96 px. Reader height is 121 px at 844x390 and 174 px at 390x440; whole-frame inspection confirms the header and composer still fit.
resolution.scope: Resolution is based on these pixels, not on a claim about data loss, root cause, smoothness or interaction behavior.

nonblockingObservations.observation: The long English name is ellipsized in the material list and only its beginning fits in the single-line name editor. Paragraphs, close and save controls remain legible and inside the modal.
nonblockingObservations.implication: Users comparing similarly prefixed filenames may need to move through the name field; no interaction failure is demonstrated.

nonblockingObservations.observation: The bounded draft area begins with a partly clipped line at its internal top edge in these captured scroll positions. Trailing text and all toolbar actions remain visible.
nonblockingObservations.implication: Minor presentation detail at an internal text-scroll boundary. These two files are unchanged after refresh, so the observation remains. No scrolling failure is demonstrated and this is not a blocker.

coverage.assessment: The material sidebar, constrained central reading column and composer share a coherent hierarchy. Main controls and preset-answer disclosures remain visible in the reviewed frames.
Header and primary controls stay within the viewport. At reading end, both attached files, copy action, three continuation controls and composer are visible together.
Counts, checkboxes, item names and menus are distinct. The ten-item frame shows disabled addition; the list-end frame shows the last complete card above the fixed local-storage footer.

Visible English paragraphs wrap without page overflow; paragraph spacing supports reading. Modal actions remain inside the frame. The long unbroken reference mentioned in metadata is not visible in the supplied editor captures and was not visually verified.

coverage.area: Long Chinese draft and submitted question
coverage.assessment: Expanded editors show readable paragraphs with completion/close controls. Submitted questions use an explicit expansion link and a visible ellipsis; sample-answer labeling remains below the preview.

Final 320x740, 844x390 and 390x440 captures all show trailing draft text and toolbar controls. The formerly blank landscape region is resolved; the narrow frame still shows a partly clipped first visible line at the internal scroll edge.

comparisons.observation: The final title and headings have clearer weight hierarchy, the title wraps without clipping, and both toolbar rows and labeled bottom navigation fit inside the frame. The new filled brand mark is visually distinct from the outline note-navigation icon.

observations.assessment: Title, section headings, paragraph text, bold clauses and citation badges have distinct hierarchy. Chinese glyphs and line spacing remain readable in both the normal serif view and the larger sans-serif reading view. No overlapping text or cut-off title was observed.

Formatting glyphs use consistent stroke and spacing; groups and undo/redo are separated. Phone overflow reveals labeled italic and quote controls in a distinct additional row. Bottom discussion/note/material destinations retain visible labels and an active-state background. Several secondary phone-header actions remain icon-only; the stills do not establish tooltip or accessible-name behavior.

The reading frame removes the formatting row and exposes a labeled edit action. The selection frame visibly shows the active italic control and a mixed Chinese/English selection. Citation context presents the current excerpt distinctly with reachable return and cite/discuss actions; the outline-location frame visibly marks the destination heading. These are state observations, not independent proof of the transitions or document correctness.

No page-edge horizontal clipping was seen. At 320 px, title/body wrap while toolbar and bottom navigation remain inside the viewport. The normal settings modal shows choices and Done together. The 390x500 frame is scrolled within the dialog and shows its lower settings/preview and Done; its upper heading and close icon are not visible in that captured scroll position, so the frame establishes lower-action reachability only.

The fallback-font frame is visibly thinner than the normal font state but remains readable and keeps title, toolbar and navigation inside the frame. The storage-failure frame has an amber explanatory banner, a visible backup action and an unsaved status, while the editable title and main content remain visible. Persistence, recovery and successful export were not independently tested in this review.

The specimen shows labeled 16 px SVG/ICO and 32 px PNG samples on light and dark cards, plus a constructed title strip. At normal specimen scale and enlarged pixel inspection, the page silhouette, central page split and right-side accent remain present. The in-app header uses the same filled-book identity distinctly from functional outline icons.
observations.limit: This is a constructed size specimen. No native browser tab strip, real browser favicon rasterization, active/inactive browser theme or operating-system integration was observed.

limits: Read-only visual review. No app or server was operated and no project source or DESIGN_NOTES.md was read or modified.
No user preference, motion smoothness, continuous rendering, typing latency or focus-transition behavior is inferred from still images.
Editing correctness, version restore, v1 import/export compatibility, citation insertion/return, keyboard semantics, persistence and recovery are not independently verified here.
A storage-failure screenshot establishes the visible warning and available action, not whether the backup download succeeds.
The font-fallback frame establishes its shown rendering only; no font request log or operating-system fallback stack was independently tested.
Only the app light theme was observed. Dark backgrounds exist only in the constructed asset specimen.

Native browser tabs, actual favicon rendering in multiple browsers, physical mobile devices, virtual keyboards, IME composition, Safari, Firefox, screen readers, browser zoom and DPR variations remain unobserved.
The provided viewport dimensions describe screenshot framing. Enlarged nearest-neighbor crops were not substituted for normal-context inspection.
The source revision identity comes from the supplied revision record; this visual review is not a code or accessibility audit.

Whole phone frame has distinct title/heading/body weight, coherent toolbar glyphs, visible labeled navigation and a filled identity mark.

records.observation: The desktop settled frame gives the selected material rows distinct bounded surfaces, stronger metadata and a shared alignment; the question/answer/composer still form the main task column. This is a static look at one state.

At this scrolled reading endpoint the follow-up prompts and composer are visible, the empty composer is bounded and focused, and the material attachment remains identified. Its content/scroll differ from the before-mobile starting frame; it is not a matched repair comparison.

The new serif reading face has a more explicit title/section/body weight hierarchy; the small typography control is closer in apparent size to neighboring symbols. A filled green book mark now accompanies the name. This supports rendered appearance in this mobile frame, not native browser-tab appearance or long-term reading comfort.
